summary: This Redmi 13 5G is listed at ₹23,999, while the market reference is ₹12,999 and the best trusted store price is ₹12,499. That puts it ₹11,000 above the market reference, and the M.R.P. is 2.0x the price stores actually charge.

voices.point: Some users say it is a nice phone with a good price.
One user reported the phone was not working and not charging.
A review title says it is no longer the budget king.
